views.rationale: AAPL's Services segment grew 18% YoY, driven by App Store and AppleCare sales, while AMZN's net service sales only grew 10% YoY.
AAPL's net sales increased 9% YoY in the Americas segment, driven by higher iPhone sales, while BA's revenues decreased 1% YoY in Commercial Airplanes.
AMZN's net product sales grew 35% YoY, while BAC's sales and trading revenue only grew 10% YoY.
BAC's sales and trading revenue was $13.628 billion, while CVX's net sales were $135.987 billion, indicating a significant difference in scale.

GOOGL's other income (expense), net, increased $143 million from 2015 to 2016, while GS's net revenues were 9% lower in 2016 due to lower net revenues in Investing & Lending and lower net revenues in Investment Banking, Institutional Client Services and Investment Management.
GOOGL's other income (expense), net, increased $143 million from 2015 to 2016, while MSFT's gross margin increased $185 million or 3% in the three months ended December 31, 2016.
JNJ's sales by companies in the Asia-Pacific, Africa region achieved growth of 1.8% as compared to the prior year, including operational growth of 1.4% and a positive currency impact of 0.4%.

NEE's customer supply and proprietary power and gas trading decreased in 2016 due to lower margins and less favorable market conditions, while NVDA's gross margin depends on various factors including the mix of products sold and average selling prices.
